name: vise-dev
description: Local development marketplace — lets a clone of this repo be installed as a plugin without going through the published index. For normal installs use the rixmerz marketplace (github.com/Rixmerz/claude-plugins), which is where vise is published.

plugins.name: vise
plugins.description: Phase-gated workflow enforcer, cross-project experience memory, and git snapshots for Claude Code

plugins.name: vise-mod
plugins.description: Opt-in mod for vise: the active phase on the status line and in a pane, the phase in the system prompt, and tasky's failed fixes in a debug session. Runs inside Claude Code, unsandboxed.
